import json
R,C=19,16
grid=[[4]*C for _ in range(R)]
ones=[(2,2),(4,14),(10,10),(17,9)]
sixes=[(4,4),(6,6),(7,14),(15,2)]
for r,c in ones: grid[r][c]=1
# connect aligned 1 pairs on 45 degree slope
for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
 for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
  if abs(r2-r1)==abs(c2-c1):
   dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1; dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
   for k in range(abs(r2-r1)+1): grid[r1+dr*k][c1+dc*k]=1
# extend NW-SE diagonal through each 6 across the grid, then overlay
for r0,c0 in sixes:
 for r in range(R):
  c=c0+(r-r0)
  if 0<=c<C: grid[r][c]=6
print(json.dumps(grid))
